# Integrating Freshdesk with ACE

Integrating Freshdesk with ACE

When you connect
AI Conversation Expert

 (
ACE

, formerly RingSense) to other apps through [integrations](https://support.ringcentral.com/article-v2/setting-up-integrations-in-ai-conversation-expert.html?brand=RingCentral&product=RingEX&language=en_US),
ACE

 can use data from those apps to better understand your customer conversations. It then creates insights—like key topics, action items, or follow-ups—and sends them back into the connected app so your team can see them in the tools they already use.

##
Requirements

Admin access in
ACE

A paid Freshdesk plan (Growth, Pro, or Enterprise)

The Freshdesk Free plan doesn’t include API access, so the integration won’t work with it.

Freshdesk trial accounts have limited API access (50 calls per minute).

Your Freshdesk sub-domain (for example, if your Freshdesk address is yourcompany.freshdesk.com, enter yourcompany)

A Freshdesk API key from a Freshdesk user with admin privileges. Keys from non-admin agents won’t work because
ACE

 needs access to the Freshdesk agent list.

If you’re not a Freshdesk user with admin privileges, ask your Freshdesk admin to share the key or to complete the setup with you.

##
How
ACE

 matches calls to Freshdesk agents and contacts

ACE

 imports agents and contacts from Freshdesk so it can match each call to the right agent and contact.

**
Agents

**:
ACE

 matches
ACE

 users to Freshdesk agents by email address. The user’s email in
ACE

 must match the agent’s email in Freshdesk (not case-sensitive).
ACE

 refreshes Freshdesk agents about once an hour, so new agents can be matched after the next refresh.

**
Contacts

**:
ACE

 matches the customer on the call to a Freshdesk contact by email, work phone, or mobile phone. If
ACE

 has the customer’s email, it searches by email only and doesn’t fall back to phone numbers. If there’s no email, it searches by work phone and mobile phone.

The contact must exist in Freshdesk when
ACE

 processes the call.
ACE

 doesn’t create contacts. If no matching contact is found, the call isn’t exported to Freshdesk, but it’s still available in
ACE

. A newly created contact can take a few minutes to become searchable in Freshdesk, so create contacts before the call where possible.

##
Getting your Freshdesk API key

Log in to Freshdesk.

Click your profile picture in the top right, then click **
Profile Settings

**.

On the right side of the page, click **
View API Key

**.

Copy the key. You'll paste it into
ACE

 when you connect.

Note

Each Freshdesk agent has their own API key, and it only allows what that agent's role allows.

If the key is reset in Freshdesk, every app using it is disconnected, including
ACE

. Enter the new key in
ACE

 to reconnect.

##
Setting up the Freshdesk integration in
ACE

After a call is processed in
ACE

, it’s automatically exported to Freshdesk as a new ticket if a matching contact is found and export is turned on for that call type. The ticket includes the call title and call details, with:

**
Status

**: *
Open

*

**
Priority

**: *
Low

*

**
Source

**: *
Phone

*

**
Requester

**: The Freshdesk contact matched to the call

ACE

 doesn’t assign the ticket to a Freshdesk agent. If a call is exported again,
ACE

 updates the existing ticket instead of creating a new one.

Follow these steps to connect your
ACE

 account to Freshdesk:

Make sure you’re signed in to
ACE

[as an admin](https://support.ringcentral.com/article-v2/switching-roles-in-ai-conversation-expert.html?brand=RingCentral&product=RingEX&language=en_US).

Click your profile icon and select **
Admin Settings

**. If you’re using the
RingCentral

 app, click **
Configuration

**.

Go to the **
Integrations

** page and click the **
Catalog

** tab.

Next to **
Freshdesk

**, click **
Connect

**.

![](https://assets.ringcentral.com/content/dam/xml-assets/doc_team/en_us/ringcentral/RingSense/RingSense-for-Sales/Integrating-Freshdesk-with-ACE/images/1-connect-freshdesk.png)

**
Enter the API key

** you copied from Freshdesk.

**
Enter the Domain

** for your Freshdesk account. Enter only your sub-domain (for example, if your Freshdesk address is yourcompany.freshdesk.com, enter yourcompany).

Use the **
Import from Freshdesk

** section to select which data is sent to
ACE

.

You can import **
Agent

** and **
Contacts

**.

Required fields are selected by default and can't be cleared because Freshdesk requires them.

**
Agent

** (required): id, contact, created_at, updated_at

**
Contacts

** (required): id, name, first_name, last_name

Optional fields are selected by default. Clear any you don’t want to import. We recommend keeping email, phone, and mobile selected so
ACE

 keeps the contact details it uses for matching.

**
Contacts

** (optional): email, description, updated_at, created_at, job_title, phone, mobile, address.

![](https://assets.ringcentral.com/content/dam/xml-assets/doc_team/en_us/ringcentral/RingSense/RingSense-for-Sales/Integrating-Freshdesk-with-ACE/images/2-import-from-freshdesk.png)

Use the **
Export to Freshdesk

** section to select which types of data are sent from
ACE

 to Freshdesk.

Check the box to **
Export translations to Freshdesk

** (a) if you want AI-generated content exported in the language spoken on the call. Only one version is exported.

This applies to the AI insights you select under **
Advanced call logging

**, such as the summary, next steps, call notes, and sentiment.

When selected, this content is exported in the detected language of the call. The transcript is always exported in the language spoken on the call, whether or not this box is selected, and
ACE

 detects the call language automatically. When the box is cleared, the content is exported in English.

The system language in your
ACE

 profile settings only changes the
ACE

 interface and doesn’t affect what’s exported to Freshdesk.

The following languages are supported: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Czech, Portuguese, Dutch, Simplified Chinese, Finnish, and Bulgarian.

Check the boxes if you want to export **
Digital interactions

**, **
Phone calls

**, and/or **
Video calls

** (b). Phone calls and Video calls are selected by default.

**
Basic call logging

** is always on. It sends the call title to the Freshdesk ticket’s Subject field, and the date, host, and participants to the ticket’s Description field.

**
Advanced call logging

** (c) is on by default and adds AI insights. Use the toggle to turn it off. Select or clear any of the following. Selected insights are sent to the Description field:

Call direction

Call Duration

Call score

Link to call

Summary

Next Steps

Call notes

Sentiment

Transcript

If you want a label added to the start of each logged call title, check the box next to **
Add [RingSense] label to the beginning of the call title

**.

![](https://assets.ringcentral.com/content/dam/xml-assets/doc_team/en_us/ringcentral/RingSense/RingSense-for-Sales/Integrating-Freshdesk-with-ACE/images/3-export-to-freshdesk.png)

Click **
Sign in and connect

**. Once connected, the connection moves to the **
Connected

** tab and
ACE

 begins logging calls going forward. Only calls made after the connection are synced.

##
Managing the Freshdesk integration in
ACE

To open an existing Freshdesk connection to update the API key or change settings:

Make sure you’re signed in to
ACE

[as an admin](https://support.ringcentral.com/article-v2/switching-roles-in-ai-conversation-expert.html?brand=RingCentral&product=RingEX&language=en_US).

Click your profile icon and select **
Admin Settings

**. If you’re using the
RingCentral

 app, click **
Configuration

**.

Go to the **
Integrations

** page and click the **
Connected

** tab.

Next to Freshdesk, click **
Manage

**.

Update any settings you need, then click **
Sign in and reconnect

**, then click **
Save

**.

##
Troubleshooting

###
Issue: I can't connect
ACE

 to Freshdesk

Confirm you're using a paid Freshdesk plan. The Free plan has no API access.

Confirm the API key is correct and the domain is only your sub-domain (for example, if your Freshdesk address is yourcompany.freshdesk.com, enter yourcompany).

Confirm the API key hasn't been reset in Freshdesk. A reset disconnects
ACE

 until you enter the new key.

Confirm the key belongs to a Freshdesk user with admin privileges. Non-admin keys won’t work. Each key only allows what that agent's role allows.

###
Issue:
ACE

 was connected but stopped working

The Freshdesk API key may have been reset. Get the new key from Freshdesk and enter it in
ACE

 to reconnect.
ACE

 doesn’t detect a reset key right away. It marks the connection as having an authentication problem the next time it tries to reach Freshdesk.

###
Issue: My calls aren't showing up in Freshdesk

Calls are exported after
ACE

 finishes processing them. If no matching contact is found, the call isn’t exported. Check the following:

The user’s email in
ACE

 matches their agent email in Freshdesk. New agents can be matched after the next hourly refresh.

The contact exists in Freshdesk. If
ACE

 has the customer’s email, the contact’s email must match.
ACE

 won’t fall back to phone numbers. Otherwise, the work phone or mobile number must match.

The call type (Phone calls, Video calls, or Digital interactions) is selected under **
Export to Freshdesk

**.

Email, phone, and mobile are selected under **
Import from Freshdesk

**.

###
Issue: Where do I see the AI insights in Freshdesk?

AI insights are in the **
Description

** field of the Freshdesk ticket
ACE

 creates for the call. Only the insights you selected under **
Advanced call logging

** are included.
ACE

 doesn’t assign these tickets to an agent, so look for them under the contact (requester).
